metadata.description: Ordered interceptors wrapped around one model call: output guard, accounting, provider state and credential materialization. Stage decides nesting, not registration order.
Stage Output. Observes the streamed generation, cancels a degenerate one and asks for another attempt; gives up as LlmTurnStatus.Degenerate. Lives in SPLA.Agent, runs here.
Stage Accounting. Folds the provider token figures into the project and machine tallies and the telemetry meter, once per network attempt. Lives in SPLA.Agent, runs here.
